title: Fusions of One-Variable First-Order Modal Logics
summary: We investigate preservation results for the independent fusion of one-variable first-order modal logics. We show that, without equality, Kripke completeness and decidability of the global and local consequence relation are preserved, under both expanding and constant domain semantics. By contrast, Kripke completeness and decidability are not preserved for fusions with equality and non-rigid constants (or, equivalently, counting up to one), again for the global and local consequence and under both expanding and constant domain semantics. This result is shown by encoding Diophantine equations. Even without equality, the finite model property is only preserved in the local case. Finally, we view fusions of one-variable modal logics as fusions of propositional modal logics sharing an S5 modality and provide a general sufficient condition for transfer of Kripke completeness and decidability (but not of finite model property).

AI.title_translation: 单变量一阶模态逻辑的融合
AI.tldr: 研究了单变量一阶模态逻辑独立融合的保持性结果，发现无等词时Kripke完备性和可判定性在全局和局部推论关系下均保持，但有等词时不保持。有限模型性质仅在局部情况下保持。
AI.motivation: 研究单变量一阶模态逻辑融合的保持性结果，特别是在有无等词、不同语义和推论关系下的Kripke完备性、可判定性和有限模型性质的传递。
AI.method: 调查单变量一阶模态逻辑独立融合的保持性结果，通过展示在有无等词情况下的Kripke完备性和可判定性的保持或不保持来证明，并通过编码Diophantine方程来展示有等词情况的不保持性。此外，将单变量模态逻辑的融合视为共享S5模态的命题模态逻辑的融合，并提供了一般充分条件。
AI.result: 无等词时，Kripke完备性和全局及局部推论关系的可判定性在扩展和常数域语义下均保持。有等词和非刚性常数时，Kripke完备性和可判定性不保持，这通过编码Diophantine方程证明。即使无等词，有限模型性质也只在局部情况下保持。将单变量模态逻辑的融合视为共享S5模态的命题模态逻辑的融合，并为Kripke完备性和可判定性的传递提供了一个一般充分条件（但不包括有限模型性质）。
AI.conclusion: 单变量一阶模态逻辑的融合在Kripke完备性和可判定性方面表现出不同的保持性，这取决于是否存在等词，并且有限模型性质的保持性更为有限。通过将这些融合视为命题模态逻辑的融合，可以为Kripke完备性和可判定性的传递提供一般条件。
AI.translation: 我们研究了单变量一阶模态逻辑独立融合的保持性结果。我们表明，在没有等词的情况下，Kripke完备性以及全局和局部推论关系的可判定性在扩展域和常数域语义下都得到了保持。相比之下，对于包含等词和非刚性常数（或者等价地，计数到一）的融合，Kripke完备性和可判定性不被保持，这同样适用于全局和局部推论关系以及扩展域和常数域语义。这一结果通过编码Diophantine方程得到证明。即使没有等词，有限模型性质也仅在局部情况下保持。最后，我们将单变量模态逻辑的融合视为共享S5模态的命题模态逻辑的融合，并为Kripke完备性和可判定性的传递（但不包括有限模型性质）提供了一个一般充分条件。
AI.summary: 这篇论文研究了单变量一阶模态逻辑独立融合的保持性，重点关注Kripke完备性、可判定性和有限模型性质。研究发现，在没有等词的情况下，Kripke完备性和可判定性在全局和局部推论关系下均保持。然而，当存在等词和非刚性常数时，这些性质不被保持，这通过编码Diophantine方程得到证明。论文还指出，即使没有等词，有限模型性质也仅在局部情况下保持。最后，作者将单变量模态逻辑的融合视为共享S5模态的命题模态逻辑的融合，并提出了Kripke完备性和可判定性传递的一般充分条件。
AI.keywords: 单变量一阶模态逻辑, 逻辑融合, Kripke完备性, 可判定性, 有限模型性质
AI.comments: 这篇论文深入探讨了模态逻辑领域中一个复杂的问题，即逻辑融合的性质保持性。其创新之处在于明确区分了有无等词对Kripke完备性和可判定性保持性的影响，并通过编码Diophantine方程提供了强有力的反例。此外，将单变量模态逻辑的融合与命题模态逻辑的融合建立联系，并提供一般充分条件，为理解更广泛的逻辑融合现象提供了理论框架。论文揭示了在逻辑融合中，某些性质的保持并非理所当然，而是高度依赖于逻辑的特定特征（如等词的存在）。

title: Progressive Refinement Regulation for Accelerating Diffusion Language Model Decoding
comments: 19 pages, 10 figures, Code available upon publication
summary: Diffusion language models generate text through iterative denoising under a uniform refinement rule applied to all tokens. However, tokens stabilize at different rates in practice, leading to substantial redundant refinement and motivating refinement control over the denoising process. Existing approaches typically assess refinement necessity from instantaneous, step-level signals under a fixed decoding process. In contrast, whether a token has converged is defined by how its prediction changes along its future refinement trajectory. Moreover, changing the refinement rule reshapes future refinement trajectories, which in turn determine how refinement rules should be formulated, making refinement control inherently dynamic. We propose \emph{Progressive Refinement Regulation} (PRR), a progressive, trajectory-grounded refinement control framework that derives a token-level notion of empirical convergence progress from full decoding rollouts. Based on this signal, PRR learns a lightweight token-wise controller to regulate refinement via temperature-based distribution shaping under a progressive self-evolving training scheme. Experiments show that PRR substantially accelerates diffusion language model decoding while preserving generation quality.
comment: 19 pages, 10 figures, Code available upon publication

AI.title_translation: 渐进式细化调控加速扩散语言模型解码
AI.tldr: PRR通过轨迹导向的渐进式细化调控，显著加速扩散语言模型解码，同时保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在迭代去噪时对所有token应用统一的细化规则，但token稳定速度不同，导致大量冗余细化。现有方法基于瞬时、步级信号评估细化需求，而token的收敛应基于其未来细化轨迹的预测变化，且细化规则的改变会影响未来轨迹，使细化控制本质上是动态的。
AI.method: 提出渐进式细化调控（PRR），一个渐进的、轨迹导向的细化控制框架。它从完整的解码过程中获取token级别的经验收敛进度概念。基于此信号，PRR学习一个轻量级的token级控制器，通过基于温度的分布塑造，在渐进式自演化训练方案下调节细化。
AI.result: 实验表明PRR显著加速扩散语言模型解码，同时保持生成质量。
AI.conclusion: PRR通过其轨迹导向的渐进式细化控制框架，成功解决了扩散语言模型解码中的冗余细化问题，实现了加速且不牺牲生成质量。
AI.translation: 扩散语言模型通过对所有token应用统一的细化规则，在迭代去噪中生成文本。然而，实际上token的稳定速度不同，导致大量的冗余细化，这促使人们对去噪过程进行细化控制。现有方法通常在固定的解码过程中，从瞬时、步级信号评估细化必要性。相比之下，一个token是否收敛取决于其预测沿未来细化轨迹如何变化。此外，改变细化规则会重塑未来的细化轨迹，这反过来又决定了细化规则应如何制定，使得细化控制本质上是动态的。我们提出了“渐进式细化调控”（PRR），一个渐进的、轨迹导向的细化控制框架，它从完整的解码过程中推导出token级别的经验收敛进度概念。基于此信号，PRR学习一个轻量级的token级控制器，通过基于温度的分布塑造，在渐进式自演化训练方案下调节细化。实验表明，PRR显著加速了扩散语言模型解码，同时保持了生成质量。
AI.summary: 本文提出了渐进式细化调控（PRR）框架，旨在解决扩散语言模型解码中因token稳定速度不同而导致的冗余细化问题。PRR通过从完整解码轨迹中获取token级经验收敛进度，并学习一个轻量级控制器，利用温度基分布塑造来动态调节细化过程。实验证明，PRR能显著加速扩散语言模型解码，同时保持生成质量。
AI.keywords: 扩散语言模型, 解码加速, 渐进式细化调控, token收敛, 轨迹导向控制
AI.comments: PRR的创新点在于其轨迹导向的收敛概念和动态自演化训练方案，这解决了现有方法依赖瞬时信号的局限性，并有效提升了扩散语言模型解码效率。其重要性在于为加速扩散模型生成提供了一种新的、更精细的控制策略。

title: Augmenting representations with scientific papers
comments: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Foundation Models for Science (ICLR 2026)
summary: Astronomers have acquired vast repositories of multimodal data, including images, spectra, and time series, complemented by decades of literature that analyzes astrophysical sources. Still, these data sources are rarely systematically integrated. This work introduces a contrastive learning framework designed to align X-ray spectra with domain knowledge extracted from scientific literature, facilitating the development of shared multimodal representations. Establishing this connection is inherently complex, as scientific texts encompass a broader and more diverse physical context than spectra. We propose a contrastive pipeline that achieves a 20% Recall@1% when retrieving texts from spectra, proving that a meaningful alignment between these modalities is not only possible but capable of accelerating the interpretation of rare or poorly understood sources. Furthermore, the resulting shared latent space effectively encodes physically significant information. By fusing spectral and textual data, we improve the estimation of 20 physical variables by 16-18% over unimodal spectral baselines. Our results indicate that a Mixture of Experts (MoE) strategy, which leverages both unimodal and shared representations, yields superior performance. Finally, outlier analysis within the multimodal latent space identifies high-priority targets for follow-up investigation, including a candidate pulsating ULX (PULX) and a gravitational lens system. Importantly, this framework can be extended to other scientific domains where aligning observational data with existing literature is possible.
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Foundation Models for Science (ICLR 2026)

AI.title_translation: 利用科学论文增强表示
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个对比学习框架，用于整合天文学中的X射线光谱数据和科学文献，以创建共享的多模态表示。该方法在文本检索、物理变量估计和识别异常目标方面表现出色，并可推广到其他科学领域。
AI.motivation: 天文学家拥有大量的多模态数据（图像、光谱、时间序列）和数十年的文献，但这些数据源很少被系统地整合。将科学文本与光谱数据建立联系是复杂的，因为科学文本包含比光谱更广泛和多样化的物理背景，这促使研究开发一种能够有效整合这些模态的方法。
AI.method: 本文引入了一个对比学习框架，旨在将X射线光谱与从科学文献中提取的领域知识对齐，以促进共享多模态表示的开发。该方法提出了一种对比管道，并采用了一种专家混合（MoE）策略，该策略利用单模态和共享表示来获得卓越性能。
AI.result: 该方法在从光谱中检索文本时达到了20%的Recall@1%。生成的共享潜在空间有效编码了物理上重要的信息。与单模态光谱基线相比，物理变量的估计准确性提高了16-18%（针对20个物理变量）。专家混合（MoE）策略产生了卓越的性能。多模态潜在空间中的异常值分析识别出高优先级目标，包括一个候选脉冲超亮X射线源（PULX）和一个引力透镜系统。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在X射线光谱和科学文献之间建立有意义的对齐是可能且有效的，能够加速对稀有或理解不足源的解释。此外，该框架可以推广到其他可以将观测数据与现有文献对齐的科学领域。
AI.translation: 天文学家已经获得了大量的多模态数据存储库，包括图像、光谱和时间序列，并辅以数十年来分析天体物理源的文献。然而，这些数据源很少被系统地整合。这项工作引入了一个对比学习框架，旨在将X射线光谱与从科学文献中提取的领域知识对齐，从而促进共享多模态表示的开发。建立这种连接本质上是复杂的，因为科学文本包含比光谱更广泛和多样化的物理背景。我们提出了一种对比管道，在从光谱中检索文本时实现了20%的Recall@1%，证明了这些模态之间有意义的对齐不仅是可能的，而且能够加速对稀有或理解不足源的解释。此外，由此产生的共享潜在空间有效地编码了物理上重要的信息。通过融合光谱和文本数据，我们比单模态光谱基线将20个物理变量的估计提高了16-18%。我们的结果表明，利用单模态和共享表示的专家混合（MoE）策略产生了卓越的性能。最后，多模态潜在空间中的异常值分析识别出高优先级目标，用于后续调查，包括一个候选脉冲超亮X射线源（PULX）和一个引力透镜系统。重要的是，该框架可以推广到其他可以将观测数据与现有文献对齐的科学领域。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的对比学习框架，旨在将天文学中的X射线光谱数据与科学文献中的领域知识对齐，以创建共享的多模态表示。该方法通过一个对比管道实现了20%的文本检索Recall@1%，并使20个物理变量的估计准确率比单模态基线提高了16-18%。研究还发现，结合单模态和共享表示的专家混合策略表现更优，并能通过异常值分析识别出高优先级的天体目标。该框架有望推广到其他需要整合观测数据和文献的科学领域。
AI.keywords: 对比学习, 多模态表示, X射线光谱, 科学文献, 天体物理
AI.comments: 这项工作具有重要的创新性，它解决了天文学领域中多模态数据（光谱和文献）长期未被充分整合的问题。通过引入对比学习框架，它成功地在复杂的科学文本和具体的观测数据之间建立了有意义的连接。其成果不仅提升了物理变量的估计精度，还提供了一种识别新颖天体目标的有效手段。该框架的普适性也预示着其在其他科学领域广阔的应用前景。

title: Discovering mathematical concepts through a multi-agent system
summary: Mathematical concepts emerge through an interplay of processes, including experimentation, efforts at proof, and counterexamples. In this paper, we present a new multi-agent model for computational mathematical discovery based on this observation. Our system, conceived with research in mind, poses its own conjectures and then attempts to prove them, making decisions informed by this feedback and an evolving data distribution. Inspired by the history of Euler's conjecture for polyhedra and an open challenge in the literature, we benchmark with the task of autonomously recovering the concept of homology from polyhedral data and knowledge of linear algebra. Our system completes this learning problem. Most importantly, the experiments are ablations, statistically testing the value of the complete dynamic and controlling for experimental setup. They support our main claim: that the optimisation of the right combination of local processes can lead to surprisingly well-aligned notions of mathematical interestingness.

AI.title_translation: 通过多智能体系统发现数学概念
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的多智能体模型，用于计算数学发现，该模型通过实验、证明和反例来产生数学概念，并成功地从多面体数据和线性代数知识中恢复了同调概念。
AI.motivation: 数学概念的产生源于实验、证明和反例等过程的相互作用。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的基于观察的多智能体模型，用于计算数学发现。该系统提出猜想并尝试证明它们，其决策由反馈和不断变化的数据分布驱动。以欧拉猜想和文献中的一个开放性挑战为灵感，通过自主恢复同调概念来评估该系统。
AI.result: 该系统成功地完成了从多面体数据和线性代数知识中恢复同调概念的学习任务。实验结果支持了核心论点，即优化局部过程的组合可以产生出人意料地契合的数学趣味性概念。
AI.conclusion: 优化局部过程的正确组合可以产生出人意料地契合的数学趣味性概念。
AI.translation: 数学概念通过包括实验、证明努力和反例在内的过程而出现。在本文中，我们基于这一观察，提出了一种新的用于计算数学发现的多智能体模型。我们的系统旨在研究，提出自己的猜想，然后尝试证明它们，其决策由这种反馈和不断变化的数据分布提供信息。受到欧拉多面体猜想的历史和文献中的一个开放性挑战的启发，我们以自主恢复同调概念为基准，该概念基于多面体数据和线性代数知识。我们的系统完成了这个学习问题。最重要的是，实验进行了省略分析，对完整的动态的价值进行了统计检验，并控制了实验设置。它们支持我们的主要论点：优化正确的局部过程组合可以产生出人意料地契合的数学趣味性概念。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的多智能体模型，用于计算数学发现，该模型模拟了数学概念（如通过实验、证明和反例）的产生过程。该系统能够自主提出猜想、进行证明，并根据反馈和数据分布调整策略。通过在恢复同调概念的任务上进行基准测试，证明了该模型在处理复杂学习问题上的有效性。实验中的省略分析进一步证实了该模型的核心论点：通过优化局部过程的组合，可以有效地产生有意义的数学概念。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 数学发现, 计算数学, 同调, 猜想生成
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的多智能体方法，用于计算数学发现，这在模拟人类数学思维过程方面具有重要意义。通过将猜想生成、证明尝试和反馈驱动的学习相结合，该系统展示了在从数据中自主学习复杂数学概念方面的潜力。然而，将该模型推广到更广泛的数学领域以及评估其在真实世界研究场景中的可扩展性和效率仍是未来的重要研究方向。

title: Complete Diagrammatic Axiomatisations of Relative Entropy
summary: Relative entropy is a fundamental class of distances between probability distributions, with widespread applications in probability theory, statistics, and machine learning. In this work, we study relative entropy from a categorical perspective, viewing it as a quantitative enrichment of categories of stochastic matrices. We consider two natural monoidal structures on stochastic matrices, given by the Kronecker product and the direct sum. Our main results are complete axiomatisations of Kullback-Leibler divergence and, more generally, of Rényi divergences of arbitrary order, for each such structure. Our axiomatic theories are formulated within the framework of quantitative monoidal algebra, using a graphical language of string diagrams enriched with quantitative equations.

AI.title_translation: 相对熵的完整图示化公理化体系
AI.tldr: 研究者使用范畴论和图示化代数（字符串图）的方法，为相对熵（包括KL散度和Rényi散度）在Kronecker积和直和两种结构下提供了完备的数学公理化描述。
AI.motivation: 相对熵是概率论、统计学和机器学习中一类基础的概率分布距离，具有广泛应用。研究的动机是为相对熵提供一个系统的、基于范畴论的理解和公理化描述。
AI.method: 从范畴论角度研究相对熵，将其视为随机矩阵范畴的定量富集；利用Kronecker积和直和这两种自然张量结构；在定量张量代数框架下，使用带有定量方程的字符串图来形式化公理理论。
AI.result: 为Kullback-Leibler散度以及更一般的任意阶Rényi散度，针对Kronecker积和直和这两种张量结构，给出了完整的公理化描述。
AI.translation: 相对熵是概率分布之间距离的基本类别，在概率论、统计学和机器学习中有着广泛的应用。在这项工作中，我们从范畴论的角度研究相对熵，将其视为随机矩阵范畴的定量富集。我们考虑了随机矩阵上的两种自然张量结构，即Kronecker积和直和。我们的主要结果是针对每种结构的Kullback-Leibler散度以及更一般的任意阶Rényi散度的完整公理化描述。我们的公理理论是在定量张量代数框架内制定的，使用了富含定量方程的字符串图的图形语言。
AI.summary: 本文从范畴论视角研究相对熵，将其视为随机矩阵范畴的定量富集。研究者利用随机矩阵上的Kronecker积和直和两种自然张量结构，在定量张量代数框架下，使用带有定量方程的字符串图语言，为Kullback-Leibler散度和任意阶Rényi散度分别建立了完备的图示化公理化体系。
AI.keywords: 相对熵, 范畴论, Kullback-Leibler散度, Rényi散度, 定量张量代数
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于从范畴论（categorical perspective）的角度研究相对熵，并利用定量张量代数（quantitative monoidal algebra）的框架和带定量方程的字符串图（string diagrams）来构建公理化体系。其重要性在于为相对熵（特别是KL散度和Rényi散度）提供了完备的公理化描述。方法的严谨性和图示化表达是其亮点。

title: PTLD: Sim-to-real Privileged Tactile Latent Distillation for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Tactile dexterous manipulation is essential to automating complex household tasks, yet learning effective control policies remains a challenge. While recent work has relied on imitation learning, obtaining high quality demonstrations for multi-fingered hands via robot teleoperation or kinesthetic teaching is prohibitive. Alternatively, with reinforcement we can learn skills in simulation, but fast and realistic simulation of tactile observations is challenging. To bridge this gap, we introduce PTLD: sim-to-real Privileged Tactile Latent Distillation, a novel approach to learning tactile manipulation skills without requiring tactile simulation. Instead of simulating tactile sensors or relying purely on proprioceptive policies to transfer zero-shot sim-to-real, our key idea is to leverage privileged sensors in the real world to collect real-world tactile policy data. This data is then used to distill a robust state estimator that operates on tactile input. We demonstrate from our experiments that PTLD can be used to improve proprioceptive manipulation policies trained in simulation significantly by incorporating tactile sensing. On the benchmark in-hand rotation task, PTLD achieves a 182% improvement over a proprioception only policy. We also show that PTLD enables learning the challenging task of tactile in-hand reorientation where we see a 57% improvement in the number of goals reached over using proprioception alone. Website: https://akashsharma02.github.io/ptld-website/.

AI.title_translation: PTLD：用于灵巧操作的模拟到现实特权触觉潜在蒸馏
AI.tldr: PTLD 通过收集真实世界“特权传感器”数据并蒸馏成触觉状态估计器，解决了模拟到现实中触觉学习的难题，显著提高了灵巧操作的性能，即使在不需要触觉仿真的情况下也能实现。
AI.motivation: 学习有效的触觉灵巧操作策略具有挑战性，因为获取高质量的多指手演示成本高昂；在模拟中学习则受限于难以快速且真实地模拟触觉观测。研究旨在弥合模拟和现实之间的差距，实现在不需要触觉仿真的情况下学习触觉操作技能。
AI.method: PTLD（Privileged Tactile Latent Distillation）是一种新方法，它不模拟触觉传感器或仅依赖本体感觉策略进行零样本的模拟到现实迁移。相反，它利用真实世界中的“特权传感器”来收集真实世界的触觉策略数据，然后用这些数据来蒸馏一个在触觉输入上运行的鲁棒状态估计器。
AI.result: PTLD 显著提高了本体感觉操作策略的性能，在基准手内旋转任务中，比纯本体感觉策略提高了 182%。在学习具有挑战性的触觉手内再定向任务时，达到目标的次数比仅使用本体感觉的策略提高了 57%。
AI.conclusion: PTLD 显著提高了在模拟中训练的本体感觉操作策略的性能，并通过整合触觉感知，在具有挑战性的触觉手内再定向任务中取得了显著进展。
AI.translation: 触觉灵巧操作对于自动化复杂的家庭任务至关重要，但学习有效的控制策略仍然是一个挑战。最近的工作依赖于模仿学习，但通过机器人遥操作或运动示教为多指手获取高质量演示是不可行的。或者，通过强化学习可以在模拟中学习技能，但快速且逼真地模拟触觉观测是具有挑战性的。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了 PTLD：模拟到现实的特权触觉潜在蒸馏，一种无需要求触觉仿真的学习触觉操作技能的新方法。不是模拟触觉传感器或仅依赖本体感觉策略进行零样本模拟到现实迁移，我们的关键思想是利用真实世界中的特权传感器来收集真实世界的触觉策略数据。然后使用这些数据来蒸馏一个在触觉输入上运行的鲁棒状态估计器。我们的实验证明，PTLD 可以通过整合触觉感知，显著提高在模拟中训练的本体感觉操作策略的性能。在基准手内旋转任务上，PTLD 比纯本体感觉策略提高了 182%。我们还证明了 PTLD 能够学习具有挑战性的触觉手内再定向任务，我们看到与单独使用本体感觉相比，达到目标的次数提高了 57%。网站：https://akashsharma02.github.io/ptld-website/。
AI.summary: PTLD（Privileged Tactile Latent Distillation）是一种新的模拟到现实方法，用于学习灵巧的触觉操作技能，而无需依赖触觉仿真。它通过利用真实世界中的“特权传感器”收集数据，并蒸馏出一个基于触觉输入的鲁棒状态估计器，从而显著增强了在模拟中训练的本体感觉策略，并在手内旋转和再定向任务中取得了优于纯本体感觉方法的显著性能提升。
AI.keywords: 触觉操作, 模拟到现实, 特权传感器, 知识蒸馏, 灵巧操作
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一种不依赖触觉仿真的方法，通过利用真实世界中“特权传感器”来收集数据，并将其蒸馏成一个基于触觉输入的鲁棒状态估计器，从而有效解决了模拟到现实的迁移问题。其重要性在于为学习复杂的、依赖触觉的灵巧操作提供了新的可行途径。限制是它仍然依赖于在真实世界中收集“特权传感器”数据。

title: Still Fresh? Evaluating Temporal Drift in Retrieval Benchmarks
summary: Information retrieval (IR) benchmarks typically follow the Cranfield paradigm, relying on static and predefined corpora. However, temporal changes in technical corpora, such as API deprecations and code reorganizations, can render existing benchmarks stale. In our work, we investigate how temporal corpus drift affects FreshStack, a retrieval benchmark focused on technical domains. We examine two independent corpus snapshots of FreshStack from October 2024 and October 2025 to answer questions about LangChain. Our analysis shows that all but one query posed in 2024 remain fully supported by the 2025 corpus, as relevant documents "migrate" from LangChain to competitor repositories, such as LlamaIndex. Next, we compare the accuracy of retrieval models on both snapshots and observe only minor shifts in model rankings, with overall strong correlation of up to 0.978 Kendall $τ$ at Recall@50. These results suggest that retrieval benchmarks re-judged with evolving temporal corpora can remain reliable for retrieval evaluation. We publicly release all our artifacts at https://github.com/fresh-stack/driftbench.

AI.title_translation: 仍然新鲜吗？评估检索基准中的时间漂移
AI.tldr: 研究发现，尽管技术语料库随时间变化，但经过重新判断的检索基准仍可保持可靠性。
AI.motivation: 传统信息检索（IR）基准通常依赖静态和预定义的语料库。然而，技术语料库（如API弃用和代码重组）中的时间变化可能导致现有基准过时。本文旨在调查时间语料库漂移如何影响FreshStack这一专注于技术领域的检索基准。
AI.method: 本文通过检查FreshStack在2024年10月和2025年10月的两个独立语料库快照，来研究时间语料库漂移的影响，重点关注关于LangChain的查询。随后，比较了检索模型在两个快照上的准确性及模型排名变化。
AI.result: 分析显示，2024年提出的查询中，除一个外，其余所有查询在2025年语料库中仍得到完全支持，相关文档从LangChain“迁移”到竞争对手存储库（如LlamaIndex）。检索模型排名的变化很小，在Recall@50处整体具有高达0.978的Kendall τ强相关性。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，使用不断演变的时间语料库重新判断的检索基准在检索评估中仍能保持可靠性。
AI.translation: 信息检索（IR）基准通常遵循克兰菲尔德范式，依赖静态和预定义的语料库。然而，技术语料库中的时间变化，例如API弃用和代码重组，可能导致现有基准过时。在我们的工作中，我们调查了时间语料库漂移如何影响FreshStack，一个专注于技术领域的检索基准。我们检查了FreshStack在2024年10月和2025年10月的两个独立语料库快照，以回答有关LangChain的问题。我们的分析显示，2024年提出的查询中，除一个外，其余所有查询在2025年语料库中仍得到完全支持，因为相关文档从LangChain“迁移”到竞争对手存储库，例如LlamaIndex。接下来，我们比较了检索模型在两个快照上的准确性，并观察到模型排名只有微小的变化，在Recall@50处整体具有高达0.978的Kendall τ强相关性。这些结果表明，使用不断演变的时间语料库重新判断的检索基准在检索评估中仍能保持可靠性。我们已在https://github.com/fresh-stack/driftbench 公开所有工件。
AI.summary: 本文研究了技术语料库中的时间漂移如何影响信息检索基准的有效性。通过分析FreshStack基准在不同时间点的语料库快照，作者发现尽管相关文档会随时间从一个来源迁移到另一个来源，但大多数查询仍能得到支持，并且检索模型在不同时间快照上的性能排名表现出高度一致性。这表明，即使面对不断变化的语料库，经过重新判断的检索基准仍可用于可靠的检索评估。
AI.keywords: 信息检索, 基准评估, 时间漂移, FreshStack, 语料库演变
AI.comments: 这篇论文探讨了一个重要且实际的问题，即信息检索基准在面对动态技术语料库时如何保持其有效性。其创新之处在于通过具体案例（FreshStack和LangChain相关查询）量化了时间漂移的影响，并提出了令人鼓舞的结论，即通过重新判断，基准仍能保持可靠性。这对于未来构建和维护长期有效的IR基准具有重要的指导意义。

title: Invariant Causal Routing for Governing Social Norms in Online Market Economies
summary: Social norms are stable behavioral patterns that emerge endogenously within economic systems through repeated interactions among agents. In online market economies, such norms -- like fair exposure, sustained participation, and balanced reinvestment -- are critical for long-term stability. We aim to understand the causal mechanisms driving these emergent norms and to design principled interventions that can steer them toward desired outcomes. This is challenging because norms arise from countless micro-level interactions that aggregate into macro-level regularities, making causal attribution and policy transferability difficult. To address this, we propose \textbf{Invariant Causal Routing (ICR)}, a causal governance framework that identifies policy-norm relations stable across heterogeneous environments. ICR integrates counterfactual reasoning with invariant causal discovery to separate genuine causal effects from spurious correlations and to construct interpretable, auditable policy rules that remain effective under distribution shift. In heterogeneous agent simulations calibrated with real data, ICR yields more stable norms, smaller generalization gaps, and more concise rules than correlation or coverage baselines, demonstrating that causal invariance offers a principled and interpretable foundation for governance.

AI.title_translation: 在线市场经济中管理社会规范的不变因果路由
AI.tldr: 本文提出不变因果路由（ICR）框架，通过结合反事实推理和不变因果发现，识别在线市场经济中社会规范的稳定因果机制，并设计出在异构环境中仍有效的可解释政策规则，从而实现更稳定的规范和更好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 在线市场经济中，公平曝光、持续参与和平衡再投资等社会规范对长期稳定至关重要。然而，这些规范由无数微观互动聚合而成，导致因果归因和政策可转移性困难，难以理解其驱动机制并设计有效的干预措施。
AI.method: 提出不变因果路由（ICR）框架，这是一个因果治理框架。ICR将反事实推理与不变因果发现相结合，旨在将真实的因果效应与虚假相关性分离，并构建在分布变化下仍然有效的可解释、可审计的政策规则，以识别在异构环境中稳定的政策-规范关系。
AI.result: 在模拟中使用真实数据校准的异构代理模拟中，ICR比相关性或覆盖基线产生了更稳定的规范、更小的泛化差距和更简洁的规则。
AI.conclusion: 因果不变性为在线市场经济中的治理提供了一个有原则且可解释的基础。
AI.translation: 社会规范是经济系统内部通过代理人之间重复互动内生出现的稳定行为模式。在在线市场经济中，诸如公平曝光、持续参与和平衡再投资等规范对于长期稳定性至关重要。我们的目标是理解驱动这些新兴规范的因果机制，并设计有原则的干预措施，以引导它们实现期望的结果。这项任务具有挑战性，因为规范源于无数微观层面的互动，这些互动聚合形成宏观层面的规律，使得因果归因和政策可转移性变得困难。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了**不变因果路由（ICR）**，这是一个因果治理框架，它能够识别在异构环境中稳定的政策-规范关系。ICR将反事实推理与不变因果发现相结合，以区分真实的因果效应和虚假相关性，并构建在分布变化下仍然有效的可解释、可审计的政策规则。在使用真实数据校准的异构代理模拟中，ICR比相关性或覆盖基线产生了更稳定的规范、更小的泛化差距和更简洁的规则，这表明因果不变性为治理提供了一个有原则且可解释的基础。
AI.summary: 本文针对在线市场经济中社会规范的治理挑战，提出了不变因果路由（ICR）框架。ICR通过结合反事实推理和不变因果发现，旨在识别在异构环境下稳定的政策-规范因果关系，并构建在分布变化下仍有效的可解释政策规则。模拟结果表明，ICR能产生更稳定的规范、更小的泛化差距和更简洁的规则，为在线经济系统的治理提供了有原则且可解释的因果基础。
AI.keywords: 社会规范, 在线市场经济, 因果路由, 因果不变性, 治理
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个结合因果发现和反事实推理的框架ICR，用于治理在线市场经济中的社会规范。其重要性在于解决了微观互动聚合导致宏观规范难以归因和政策难以转移的挑战，并强调了因果不变性在设计稳健、可解释政策中的价值。该方法在处理复杂、动态的社会经济系统方面具有潜力。

title: How Professional Visual Artists are Negotiating Generative AI in the Workplace
summary: Generative AI has been heavily critiqued by artists in both popular media and HCI scholarship. However, more work is needed to understand the impacts of generative AI on professional artists' workplaces and careers. In this paper, we conduct a survey of \textit{378 verified professional visual artists} about how generative AI has impacted their careers and workplaces. We find (1) most visual artists are strongly opposed to using generative AI (text or visual) and negotiate their inclusion in the workplace through a variety of \textit{refusal} strategies (2) there exist a range of factors in artists environments shaping their use of generative AI, including pressure from clients, bosses, and peers and (3) visual artists report overwhelmingly negative impacts of generative AI on their workplaces, leading to added stress and reduced job opportunities. In light of these findings, we encourage HCI researchers to contend more deeply with artists' desires not to use generative AI in the workplace.

title: InverseNet: Benchmarking Operator Mismatch and Calibration Across Compressive Imaging Modalities
comments: Benchmarking Operator Mismatch and Calibration Across Compressive Imaging Modalities
summary: State-of-the-art EfficientSCI loses 20.58 dB when its assumed forward operator deviates from physical reality in just eight parameters, yet no existing benchmark quantifies operator mismatch, the default condition in deployed compressive imaging systems. We introduce InverseNet, the first cross-modality benchmark for operator mismatch, spanning CASSI, CACTI, and single-pixel cameras. Evaluating 12 methods under a four-scenario protocol (ideal, mismatched, oracle-corrected, blind calibration) across 27 simulated scenes and 9 real hardware captures, we find: (1) deep learning methods lose 10-21 dB under mismatch, eliminating their advantage over classical baselines; (2) performance and robustness are inversely correlated across modalities (Spearman r_s = -0.71, p < 0.01); (3) mask-oblivious architectures recover 0% of mismatch losses regardless of calibration quality, while operator-conditioned methods recover 41-90%; (4) blind grid-search calibration recovers 85-100% of the oracle bound without ground truth. Real hardware experiments confirm that simulation trends transfer to physical data. Code will be released upon acceptance.
comment: Benchmarking Operator Mismatch and Calibration Across Compressive Imaging Modalities

title: An LLM-Guided Query-Aware Inference System for GNN Models on Large Knowledge Graphs
summary: Efficient inference for graph neural networks (GNNs) on large knowledge graphs (KGs) is essential for many real-world applications. GNN inference queries are computationally expensive and vary in complexity, as each involves a different number of target nodes linked to subgraphs of diverse densities and structures. Existing acceleration methods, such as pruning, quantization, and knowledge distillation, instantiate smaller models but do not adapt them to the structure or semantics of individual queries. They also store models as monolithic files that must be fully loaded, and miss the opportunity to retrieve only the neighboring nodes and corresponding model components that are semantically relevant to the target nodes. These limitations lead to excessive data loading and redundant computation on large KGs. This paper presents KG-WISE, a task-driven inference paradigm for large KGs. KG-WISE decomposes trained GNN models into fine-grained components that can be partially loaded based on the structure of the queried subgraph. It employs large language models (LLMs) to generate reusable query templates that extract semantically relevant subgraphs for each task, enabling query-aware and compact model instantiation. We evaluate KG-WISE on six large KGs with up to 42 million nodes and 166 million edges. KG-WISE achieves up to 28x faster inference and 98% lower memory usage than state-of-the-art systems while maintaining or improving accuracy across both commercial and open-weight LLMs.

title: Oracle-efficient Hybrid Learning with Constrained Adversaries
summary:
The Hybrid Online Learning Problem, where features are drawn i.i.d. from an unknown distribution but labels are generated adversarially, is a well-motivated setting positioned between statistical and fully-adversarial online learning. Prior work has presented a dichotomy: algorithms that are statistically-optimal, but computationally intractable (Wu et al., 2023), and algorithms that are computationally-efficient (given an ERM oracle), but statistically-suboptimal (Wu et al., 2024).
  This paper takes a significant step towards achieving statistical optimality and computational efficiency simultaneously in the Hybrid Learning setting. To do so, we consider a structured setting, where the Adversary is constrained to pick labels from an expressive, but fixed, class of functions $R$. Our main result is a new learning algorithm, which runs efficiently given an ERM oracle and obtains regret scaling with the Rademacher complexity of a class derived from the Learner's hypothesis class $H$ and the Adversary's label class $R$. As a key corollary, we give an oracle-efficient algorithm for computing equilibria in stochastic zero-sum games when action sets may be high-dimensional but the payoff function exhibits a type of low-dimensional structure. Technically, we develop a number of tools for the design and analysis of our learning algorithm, including a novel Frank-Wolfe reduction with "truncated entropy regularizer" and a new tail bound for sums of "hybrid" martingale difference sequences.

title: Many-RRT*: Robust Joint-Space Trajectory Planning for Serial Manipulators
summary: The rapid advancement of high degree-of-freedom (DoF) serial manipulators necessitates the use of swift, sampling-based motion planners for high-dimensional spaces. While sampling-based planners like the Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree (RRT) are widely used, planning in the manipulator's joint space presents significant challenges due to non-invertible forward kinematics. A single task-space end-effector pose can correspond to multiple configuration-space states, creating a multi-arm bandit problem for the planner. In complex environments, simply choosing the wrong joint space goal can result in suboptimal trajectories or even failure to find a viable plan. To address this planning problem, we propose Many-RRT*: an extension of RRT*-Connect that plans to multiple goals in parallel. By generating multiple IK solutions and growing independent trees from these goal configurations simultaneously alongside a single start tree, Many-RRT* ensures that computational effort is not wasted on suboptimal IK solutions. This approach maintains robust convergence and asymptotic optimality. Experimental evaluations across robot morphologies and diverse obstacle environments demonstrate that Many-RRT* provides higher quality trajectories (44.5% lower cost in the same runtime) with a significantly higher success rate (100% vs. the next best of 1.6%) than previous RRT iterations without compromising on runtime performance.

title: Adaptive Memory Admission Control for LLM Agents
summary: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to support multi-session reasoning and interaction, yet current systems provide little control over what information is retained. In practice, agents either accumulate large volumes of conversational content, including hallucinated or obsolete facts, or depend on opaque, fully LLM-driven memory policies that are costly and difficult to audit. As a result, memory admission remains a poorly specified and weakly controlled component in agent architectures. To address this gap, we propose Adaptive Memory Admission Control (A-MAC), a framework that treats memory admission as a structured decision problem. A-MAC decomposes memory value into five complementary and interpretable factors: future utility, factual confidence, semantic novelty, temporal recency, and content type prior. The framework combines lightweight rule-based feature extraction with a single LLM-assisted utility assessment, and learns domain-adaptive admission policies through cross-validated optimization. This design enables transparent and efficient control over long-term memory. Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark show that A-MAC achieves a superior precision-recall tradeoff, improving F1 to 0.583 while reducing latency by 31% compared to state-of-the-art LLM-native memory systems. Ablation results identify content type prior as the most influential factor for reliable memory admission. These findings demonstrate that explicit and interpretable admission control is a critical design principle for scalable and reliable memory in LLM-based agents.

title: Transformer-Based Multipath Congestion Control: A Decoupled Approach for Wireless Uplinks
summary: The proliferation of artificial intelligence applications on edge devices necessitates efficient transport protocols that leverage multi-homed connectivity across heterogeneous networks. While Multipath TCP enables bandwidth aggregation, its in-kernel congestion control mechanisms lack the programmability and flexibility needed for achieving efficient transmission. Additionally, inherent measurement noise renders network state partially observable, challenging data-driven approaches like deep reinforcement learning (DRL). To address these challenges, we propose a Transformer-based Congestion Control Optimization (TCCO) framework for multipath transport. TCCO employs a decoupled architecture that offloads control decisions to an external decision engine via a lightweight in-kernel client and user-space proxy, enabling edge devices to leverage external computational resources while maintaining TCP/IP compatibility. The Transformer-based DRL agent in the external decision engine uses self-attention to capture temporal dependencies, filter noise, and coordinate control across subflows through a unified policy. Extensive evaluation on both simulated and real dual-band Wi-Fi testbeds demonstrates that TCCO achieves superior adaptability and performance than state-of-the-art baselines, validating the feasibility and effectiveness of TCCO for wireless networks.

title: Beyond the Interface: Redefining UX for Society-in-the-Loop AI Systems
summary:
Artificial intelligence systems increasingly operate in decision-critical environments where probabilistic outputs and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) interactions reshape user engagement. Traditional user experience (UX) frameworks, designed for deterministic systems, fail to capture these evolving sociotechnical dynamics. This paper argues that in AI-enabled HITL systems, UX must transcend frontend usability to encompass backend performance, organizational workflows, and decision making structures.
  We employ a mixed-methods approach, combining an inductive social construction analysis of 269 stakeholder insights with the deployment of an operational HITL video anomaly detection system. Our findings reveal that stakeholders experience AI through multifaceted themes: risk, governance, and organizational capacity. Experimental results further demonstrate how detection behavior and alert routing directly calibrate human oversight and workload. Grounded in these results, we formalize a new evaluative framework centered on four sociotechnical metrics: Accuracy (FPR/FNR), Operational Latency (response time), Adaptation Time (deployment burden), and Trust (validated automation scales). This framework redefines UX as a multi-layered construct spanning infrastructure and governance, providing a rigorous foundation for evaluating AI systems embedded within complex real-world ecosystems.

title: Latent Particle World Models: Self-supervised Object-centric Stochastic Dynamics Modeling
summary: We introduce Latent Particle World Model (LPWM), a self-supervised object-centric world model scaled to real-world multi-object datasets and applicable in decision-making. LPWM autonomously discovers keypoints, bounding boxes, and object masks directly from video data, enabling it to learn rich scene decompositions without supervision. Our architecture is trained end-to-end purely from videos and supports flexible conditioning on actions, language, and image goals. LPWM models stochastic particle dynamics via a novel latent action module and achieves state-of-the-art results on diverse real-world and synthetic datasets. Beyond stochastic video modeling, LPWM is readily applicable to decision-making, including goal-conditioned imitation learning, as we demonstrate in the paper. Code, data, pre-trained models and video rollouts are available: https://taldatech.github.io/lpwm-web

title: Token Taxes: mitigating AGI's economic risks
comments: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Post-AGI Science and Society Workshop (OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=03tzkncv2c)
summary: The development of AGI threatens to erode government tax bases, lower living standards, and disempower citizens -- risks that make the 40-year stagnation of wages during the first industrial revolution look mild in comparison. While AI safety research has focused primarily on capability risks, comparatively little work has studied how to mitigate the economic risks of AGI. In this paper, we argue that the economic risks posed by a post-AGI world can be effectively mitigated by token taxes: usage-based surcharges on model inference applied at the point of sale. We situate token taxes within previous proposals for robot taxes and identify two key advantages: they are enforceable through existing compute governance infrastructure, and they capture value where AI is used rather than where models are hosted. For enforcement, we outline a staged audit pipeline -- black-box token verification, norm-based tax rates, and white-box audits. For impact, we highlight the need for agent-based modeling of token taxes' economic effects. Finally, we discuss alternative approaches including FLOP taxes, and how to prevent AI superpowers vetoing such measures.

title: From Local Corrections to Generalized Skills: Improving Neuro-Symbolic Policies with MEMO
summary: Recent works use a neuro-symbolic framework for general manipulation policies. The advantage of this framework is that -- by applying off-the-shelf vision and language models -- the robot can break complex tasks down into semantic subtasks. However, the fundamental bottleneck is that the robot needs skills to ground these subtasks into embodied motions. Skills can take many forms (e.g., trajectory snippets, motion primitives, coded functions), but regardless of their form skills act as a constraint. The high-level policy can only ground its language reasoning through the available skills; if the robot cannot generate the right skill for the current task, its policy will fail. We propose to address this limitation -- and dynamically expand the robot's skills -- by leveraging user feedback. When a robot fails, humans can intuitively explain what went wrong (e.g., ``no, go higher''). While a simple approach is to recall this exact text the next time the robot faces a similar situation, we hypothesize that by collecting, clustering, and re-phrasing natural language corrections across multiple users and tasks, we can synthesize more general text guidance and coded skill templates. Applying this hypothesis we develop Memory Enhanced Manipulation (MEMO). MEMO builds and maintains a retrieval-augmented skillbook gathered from human feedback and task successes. At run time, MEMO retrieves relevant text and code from this skillbook, enabling the robot's policy to generate new skills while reasoning over multi-task human feedback. Our experiments demonstrate that using MEMO to aggregate local feedback into general skill templates enables generalization to novel tasks where existing baselines fall short. See supplemental material here: https://collab.me.vt.edu/memo

title: Fusion and Grouping Strategies in Deep Learning for Local Climate Zone Classification of Multimodal Remote Sensing Data
summary: Local Climate Zones (LCZs) give a zoning map to study urban structures and land use and analyze the impact of urbanization on local climate. Multimodal remote sensing enables LCZ classification, for which data fusion is significant for improving accuracy owing to the data complexity. However, there is a gap in a comprehensive analysis of the fusion mechanisms used in their deep learning (DL) classifier architectures. This study analyzes different fusion strategies in the multi-class LCZ classification models for multimodal data and grouping strategies based on inherent data characteristics. The different models involving Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) include: (i) baseline hybrid fusion (FM1), (ii) with self- and cross-attention mechanisms (FM2), (iii) with the multi-scale Gaussian filtered images (FM3), and (iv) weighted decision-level fusion (FM4). Ablation experiments are conducted to study the pixel-, feature-, and decision-level fusion effects in the model performance. Grouping strategies include band grouping (BG) within the data modalities and label merging (LM) in the ground truth. Our analysis is exclusively done on the So2Sat LCZ42 dataset, which consists of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and Multispectral Imaging (MSI) image pairs. Our results show that FM1 consistently outperforms simple fusion methods. FM1 with BG and LM is found to be the most effective approach among all fusion strategies, giving an overall accuracy of 76.6\%. Importantly, our study highlights the effect of these strategies in improving prediction accuracy for the underrepresented classes. Our code and processed datasets are available at https://github.com/GVCL/LCZC-MultiModalHybridFusion

title: Structure-Guided Histopathology Synthesis via Dual-LoRA Diffusion
summary:
Histopathology image synthesis plays an important role in tissue restoration, data augmentation, and modeling of tumor microenvironments. However, existing generative methods typically address restoration and generation as separate tasks, although both share the same objective of structure-consistent tissue synthesis under varying degrees of missingness, and often rely on weak or inconsistent structural priors that limit realistic cellular organization.
  We propose Dual-LoRA Controllable Diffusion, a unified centroid-guided diffusion framework that jointly supports Local Structure Completion and Global Structure Synthesis within a single model. Multi-class nuclei centroids serve as lightweight and annotation-efficient spatial priors, providing biologically meaningful guidance under both partial and complete image absence. Two task-specific LoRA adapters specialize the shared backbone for local and global objectives without retraining separate diffusion models. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art GAN and diffusion baselines across restoration and synthesis tasks.
  For local completion, LPIPS computed within the masked region improves from 0.1797 (HARP) to 0.1524, and for global synthesis, FID improves from 225.15 (CoSys) to 76.04, indicating improved structural fidelity and realism. Our approach achieves more faithful structural recovery in masked regions and substantially improved realism and morphology consistency in full synthesis, supporting scalable pan-cancer histopathology modeling.

title: Mask-aware inference with State-Space Models
summary: Many real-world computer vision tasks, such as depth completion, must handle inputs with arbitrarily shaped regions of missing or invalid data. For Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Partial Convolutions solved this by a mask-aware re-normalization conditioned only on valid pixels. Recently, State Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba have emerged, offering high performance with linear complexity. However, these architectures lack an inherent mechanism for handling such arbitrarily shaped invalid data at inference time. To bridge this gap, we introduce Partial Vision Mamba (PVM), a novel architectural component that ports the principles of partial operations to the Mamba backbone. We also define a series of rules to design architectures using PVM. We show the efficacy and generalizability of our approach in the tasks of depth completion, image inpainting, and classification with invalid data.

title: Distributed State Estimation for Vision-Based Cooperative Slung Load Transportation in GPS-Denied Environments
comments: In proceedings of the 2026 AIAA SciTech Forum, Session: Intelligent Systems-27
summary: Transporting heavy or oversized slung loads using rotorcraft has traditionally relied on single-aircraft systems, which limits both payload capacity and control authority. Cooperative multilift using teams of rotorcraft offers a scalable and efficient alternative, especially for infrequent but challenging "long-tail" payloads without the need of building larger and larger rotorcraft. Most prior multilift research assumes GPS availability, uses centralized estimation architectures, or relies on controlled laboratory motion-capture setups. As a result, these methods lack robustness to sensor loss and are not viable in GPS-denied or operationally constrained environments. This paper addresses this limitation by presenting a distributed and decentralized payload state estimation framework for vision-based multilift operations. Using onboard monocular cameras, each UAV detects a fiducial marker on the payload and estimates its relative pose. These measurements are fused via a Distributed and Decentralized Extended Information Filter (DDEIF), enabling robust and scalable estimation that is resilient to individual sensor dropouts. This payload state estimate is then used for closed-loop trajectory tracking control. Monte Carlo simulation results in Gazebo show the effectiveness of the proposed approach, including the effect of communication loss during flight.

AI.title_translation: GPS拒止环境下基于视觉的协同吊运分布式状态估计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于GPS拒止环境下基于视觉的协同吊运操作的分布式去中心化载荷状态估计算法，通过机载单目摄像头和分布式扩展信息滤波器实现鲁棒和可扩展的估计，并已在Gazebo仿真中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统的单飞机吊运系统在载荷能力和控制权限上都有限制。合作多机吊运是可扩展且高效的替代方案，特别适用于不常见但具有挑战性的“长尾”载荷。然而，大多数先前的多机吊运研究假设GPS可用，使用集中式估计架构，或依赖受控实验室运动捕捉设置，导致这些方法缺乏对传感器丢失的鲁棒性，并且在GPS拒止或操作受限的环境中不可行。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种用于基于视觉的多机吊运操作的分布式去中心化载荷状态估计框架。每架无人机使用机载单目摄像头检测载荷上的一个基准标记并估计其相对姿态。这些测量值通过分布式去中心化扩展信息滤波器（DDEIF）进行融合，从而实现对单个传感器掉线具有弹性的鲁棒和可扩展估计。然后，该载荷状态估计用于闭环轨迹跟踪控制。
AI.result: Gazebo中的蒙特卡洛仿真结果显示了所提出方法的有效性，包括飞行过程中通信丢失的影响。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的分布式去中心化载荷状态估计框架，通过机载单目摄像头和DDEIF，能够为GPS拒止环境下的视觉多机吊运操作提供鲁棒、可扩展且对传感器掉线具有弹性的载荷状态估计，并可用于闭环轨迹跟踪控制。
AI.translation: 使用旋翼机运输重型或超大型吊运载荷传统上依赖于单飞机系统，这限制了有效载荷能力和控制权限。使用旋翼机团队进行合作多机吊运提供了一种可扩展且高效的替代方案，特别是对于不常见但具有挑战性的“长尾”载荷，而无需建造越来越大的旋翼机。大多数先前的多机吊运研究假设GPS可用，使用集中式估计架构，或依赖受控实验室运动捕捉设置。因此，这些方法缺乏对传感器丢失的鲁棒性，并且在GPS拒止或操作受限的环境中不可行。本文通过提出一种用于基于视觉的多机吊运操作的分布式去中心化载荷状态估计框架来解决这一限制。每架无人机使用机载单目摄像头检测载荷上的一个基准标记并估计其相对姿态。这些测量值通过分布式去中心化扩展信息滤波器（DDEIF）进行融合，从而实现对单个传感器掉线具有弹性的鲁棒和可扩展估计。然后，该载荷状态估计用于闭环轨迹跟踪控制。Gazebo中的蒙特卡洛仿真结果显示了所提出方法的有效性，包括飞行过程中通信丢失的影响。
AI.summary: 本文针对GPS拒止环境下合作多机吊运的挑战，提出了一种分布式去中心化载荷状态估计框架。该框架利用每架无人机上的单目摄像头检测载荷上的基准标记，并通过分布式去中心化扩展信息滤波器（DDEIF）融合相对姿态测量，从而实现对传感器丢失具有鲁棒性和可扩展性的载荷状态估计。该估计结果进一步用于闭环轨迹跟踪控制，并通过Gazebo仿真验证了其有效性，包括在通信丢失情况下的性能。
AI.keywords: 分布式状态估计, 协同吊运, GPS拒止环境, 视觉导航, DDEIF
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个适用于GPS拒止环境下的分布式去中心化载荷状态估计框架，克服了传统方法对GPS依赖和集中式架构的局限性。通过利用机载视觉传感器和DDEIF，实现了对传感器故障具有弹性的鲁棒和可扩展的估计，这对于实际操作环境具有重要意义。该方法为未来在复杂和受限环境下进行多机协同作业提供了新的思路和技术支持。

title: Risk-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Mobile Manipulation
summary: For robots to successfully transition from lab settings to everyday environments, they must begin to reason about the risks associated with their actions and make informed, risk-aware decisions. This is particularly true for robots performing mobile manipulation tasks, which involve both interacting with and navigating within dynamic, unstructured spaces. However, existing whole-body controllers for mobile manipulators typically lack explicit mechanisms for risk-sensitive decision-making under uncertainty. To our knowledge, we are the first to (i) learn risk-aware visuomotor policies for mobile manipulation conditioned on egocentric depth observations with runtime-adjustable risk sensitivity, and (ii) show risk-aware behaviours can be transferred through Imitation Learning (IL) to a visuomotor policy conditioned on egocentric depth observations. Our method achieves this by first training a privileged teacher policy using Distributional Reinforcement Learning (DRL), with a risk-neutral distributional critic. Distortion risk-metrics are then applied to the critic's predicted return distribution to calculate risk-adjusted advantage estimates used in policy updates to achieve a range of risk-aware behaviours. We then distil teacher policies with IL to obtain risk-aware student policies conditioned on egocentric depth observations. We perform extensive evaluations demonstrating that our trained visuomotor policies exhibit risk-aware behaviour (specifically achieving better worst-case performance) while performing reactive whole-body motions in unmapped environments, leveraging live depth observations for perception.

AI.title_translation: 移动操作中的风险感知强化学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种学习风险感知视觉运动策略的方法，用于移动操作，并通过模仿学习将其转移到学生策略中，以实现更好的最坏情况性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人需要从实验室走向日常环境，尤其是在动态、非结构化空间中执行移动操作任务时，必须能够推理其行动的风险并做出风险感知决策。现有全身控制器缺乏风险敏感决策机制。
AI.method: 该方法首先使用分布式强化学习（DRL）训练一个特权教师策略，该策略包含一个风险中性分布评论家。接着，将扭曲风险度量应用于评论家预测的回报分布，计算风险调整的优势估计，用于策略更新以实现一系列风险感知行为。最后，通过模仿学习（IL）蒸馏教师策略，获得以自我中心深度观测为条件的风险感知学生策略。
AI.result: 训练的视觉运动策略在未映射环境中执行反应性全身运动时，利用实时深度观测进行感知，表现出风险感知行为，特别是实现了更好的最坏情况性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次学习了基于自我中心深度观测的、运行时可调风险敏感度的移动操作风险感知视觉运动策略，并证明了风险感知行为可以通过模仿学习转移到学生策略中。该方法在未映射环境中实现了更好的最坏情况性能。
AI.translation: 为了让机器人成功地从实验室环境过渡到日常环境，它们必须开始推理与其行动相关的风险，并做出明智的、风险感知的决策。对于执行移动操作任务的机器人来说尤其如此，这些任务涉及在动态、非结构化空间中进行交互和导航。然而，现有的移动机械手全身控制器通常缺乏在不确定性下进行风险敏感决策的明确机制。据我们所知，我们是第一个（i）学习基于自我中心深度观测的、运行时可调风险敏感度的移动操作风险感知视觉运动策略，并且（ii）展示风险感知行为可以通过模仿学习（IL）转移到基于自我中心深度观测的视觉运动策略中。我们的方法首先使用分布式强化学习（DRL）训练一个特权教师策略，其中包含一个风险中性分布式评论家。然后，将扭曲风险度量应用于评论家预测的回报分布，以计算用于策略更新的风险调整优势估计，从而实现一系列风险感知行为。接着，我们通过模仿学习将教师策略蒸馏，以获得基于自我中心深度观测的风险感知学生策略。我们进行了广泛的评估，证明我们训练的视觉运动策略在未映射环境中执行反应性全身运动时，利用实时深度观测进行感知，表现出风险感知行为（特别是实现了更好的最坏情况性能）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法，通过结合分布式强化学习和模仿学习，为移动操作机器人学习风险感知视觉运动策略。该方法首先训练一个使用扭曲风险度量调整优势估计的特权教师策略，然后通过模仿学习将其知识蒸馏到以自我中心深度观测为条件的学生策略中。实验证明，该方法在未映射环境中能使机器人表现出风险感知行为，尤其在最坏情况性能上有所提升。
AI.keywords: 风险感知强化学习, 移动操作, 分布式强化学习, 模仿学习, 视觉运动策略
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于首次将风险感知学习与视觉运动策略相结合，并成功地通过模仿学习将这种风险感知能力从教师策略转移到学生策略。这对于机器人从受控环境走向真实世界至关重要，因为在实际应用中，规避风险和处理不确定性是核心挑战。该方法通过引入运行时可调的风险敏感度，为机器人在不同风险偏好下做出决策提供了灵活性。

title: Why Do Neural Networks Forget: A Study of Collapse in Continual Learning
summary: Catastrophic forgetting is a major problem in continual learning, and lots of approaches arise to reduce it. However, most of them are evaluated through task accuracy, which ignores the internal model structure. Recent research suggests that structural collapse leads to loss of plasticity, as evidenced by changes in effective rank (eRank). This indicates a link to forgetting, since the networks lose the ability to expand their feature space to learn new tasks, which forces the network to overwrite existing representations. Therefore, in this study, we investigate the correlation between forgetting and collapse through the measurement of both weight and activation eRank. To be more specific, we evaluated four architectures, including MLP, ConvGRU, ResNet-18, and Bi-ConvGRU, in the split MNIST and Split CIFAR-100 benchmarks. Those models are trained through the SGD, Learning-without-Forgetting (LwF), and Experience Replay (ER) strategies separately. The results demonstrate that forgetting and collapse are strongly related, and different continual learning strategies help models preserve both capacity and performance in different efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 神经网络为何遗忘：持续学习中崩溃现象的研究
AI.tldr: 本研究通过测量权重和激活的有效秩（eRank），探讨了持续学习中灾难性遗忘与模型结构崩溃之间的相关性，发现两者密切相关，并且不同的持续学习策略在保留模型容量和性能方面效率不同。
AI.motivation: 持续学习中的灾难性遗忘是一个主要问题，现有方法大多通过任务准确性评估，忽略了内部模型结构。最近研究表明结构崩溃（表现为有效秩eRank的变化）会导致可塑性丧失，从而导致网络遗忘现有表示。因此，本研究旨在调查遗忘与崩溃之间的相关性。
AI.method: 研究通过测量权重和激活的有效秩（eRank）来调查遗忘与崩溃之间的相关性。评估了四种架构（MLP、ConvGRU、ResNet-18、Bi-ConvGRU）在Split MNIST和Split CIFAR-100基准上的表现。这些模型分别通过SGD、Learning-without-Forgetting (LwF) 和 Experience Replay (ER) 策略进行训练。
AI.result: 结果表明，遗忘与崩溃之间存在强烈的相关性。不同的持续学习策略在不同效率下有助于模型保持容量和性能。
AI.conclusion: 本研究得出结论，持续学习中的遗忘与模型结构崩溃（通过有效秩测量）密切相关。不同的持续学习策略在减轻遗忘和保持模型结构完整性方面表现出不同的效率。
AI.translation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习中的一个主要问题，许多方法旨在减少它。然而，它们中的大多数通过任务准确性进行评估，这忽略了内部模型结构。最近的研究表明，结构崩溃导致可塑性丧失，这通过有效秩（eRank）的变化得到证实。这表明与遗忘存在联系，因为网络失去了扩展其特征空间以学习新任务的能力，这迫使网络覆盖现有表示。因此，在本研究中，我们通过测量权重和激活的eRank来调查遗忘与崩溃之间的相关性。具体来说，我们在Split MNIST和Split CIFAR-100基准上评估了四种架构，包括MLP、ConvGRU、ResNet-18和Bi-ConvGRU。这些模型分别通过SGD、Learning-without-Forgetting (LwF) 和 Experience Replay (ER) 策略进行训练。结果表明，遗忘与崩溃密切相关，并且不同的持续学习策略以不同的效率帮助模型保持容量和性能。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了持续学习中神经网络灾难性遗忘与内部结构崩溃之间的关联。通过测量权重和激活的有效秩（eRank），研究评估了MLP、ConvGRU、ResNet-18和Bi-ConvGRU四种架构在Split MNIST和Split CIFAR-100基准上的表现，并使用了SGD、LwF和ER三种训练策略。结果显示，遗忘与模型结构崩溃之间存在强相关性，且不同的持续学习策略在保持模型容量和性能方面表现出不同的效率。
AI.keywords: 持续学习, 灾难性遗忘, 结构崩溃, 有效秩, 神经网络
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与神经网络的内部结构崩溃（通过有效秩衡量）联系起来，为理解遗忘机制提供了新的视角。强调了不仅仅关注任务准确性，还应关注模型内部结构变化的重要性。研究结果对未来设计更有效的持续学习算法具有指导意义。

title: Self-Attribution Bias: When AI Monitors Go Easy on Themselves
summary: Agentic systems increasingly rely on language models to monitor their own behavior. For example, coding agents may self critique generated code for pull request approval or assess the safety of tool-use actions. We show that this design pattern can fail when the action is presented in a previous or in the same assistant turn instead of being presented by the user in a user turn. We define self-attribution bias as the tendency of a model to evaluate an action as more correct or less risky when the action is implicitly framed as its own, compared to when the same action is evaluated under off-policy attribution. Across four coding and tool-use datasets, we find that monitors fail to report high-risk or low-correctness actions more often when evaluation follows a previous assistant turn in which the action was generated, compared to when the same action is evaluated in a new context presented in a user turn. In contrast, explicitly stating that the action comes from the monitor does not by itself induce self-attribution bias. Because monitors are often evaluated on fixed examples rather than on their own generated actions, these evaluations can make monitors appear more reliable than they actually are in deployment, leading developers to unknowingly deploy inadequate monitors in agentic systems.

AI.title_translation: 自我归因偏差：当AI监控者对自己手下留情时
AI.tldr: 当AI监控器评估自己的行为时，它们会对其进行更有利（更正确或风险更低）的评价，尤其是在其自己的前一个回合中呈现时。这导致了对其在实际部署中可靠性的过高估计。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统越来越依赖语言模型来监控自身的行为（例如，代码智能体自我批评生成的代码，或评估工具使用操作的安全性）。本文研究了这种设计模式可能失败的情况，即当动作不是由用户在用户回合中呈现，而是在前一个或同一个助手回合中呈现时。这可能导致开发者在不知情的情况下部署不充分的监控器，从而影响智能体系统的可靠性。
AI.method: 研究定义了“自我归因偏差”，即模型在评估被隐式地视为其自身的行为时，倾向于将其评估为更正确或风险更低，而不是在离策略归因下评估相同的行为。研究在四个编码和工具使用数据集上进行了实验，比较了当评估紧随生成动作的先前助手回合之后，与当相同动作在用户回合中呈现的新上下文中进行评估时的表现。此外，研究还测试了明确声明动作来自监控器是否会诱导自我归因偏差。
AI.result: 研究发现，当评估紧随生成动作的先前助手回合之后时，监控器未能报告高风险或低正确性动作的频率更高，而当相同动作在用户回合中呈现的新上下文中进行评估时则不然。相反，明确声明动作来自监控器本身并不会诱导自我归因偏差。
AI.conclusion: 由于监控器通常在固定示例而非自身生成的动作上进行评估，这些评估可能会使监控器在部署时显得比实际更可靠，导致开发者在不知情的情况下部署不充分的监控器到智能体系统中。
AI.translation: 智能体系统越来越依赖语言模型来监控自身的行为。例如，编码智能体可能会自评生成的代码以进行拉取请求批准，或评估工具使用操作的安全性。我们发现，当动作在先前或同一个助手回合中呈现，而不是由用户在用户回合中呈现时，这种设计模式可能会失败。我们将自我归因偏差定义为：与在离策略归因下评估相同的动作相比，当动作被隐式地视为其自身的时，模型倾向于将其评估为更正确或风险更低。在四个编码和工具使用数据集上，我们发现，与当相同动作在用户回合中呈现的新上下文中进行评估相比，当评估紧随生成动作的先前助手回合之后时，监控器未能报告高风险或低正确性动作的频率更高。相反，明确声明动作来自监控器本身并不会诱导自我归因偏差。由于监控器通常在固定示例而非自身生成的动作上进行评估，这些评估可能会使监控器在部署时显得比实际更可靠，导致开发者在不知情的情况下部署不充分的监控器到智能体系统中。
AI.summary: 本文引入了“自我归因偏差”的概念，指出AI监控器在评估自身行为时存在偏见。研究发现，当动作被隐式地视为监控器自身的，尤其是在其生成该动作的先前助手回合之后进行评估时，监控器倾向于将其评估为更正确或风险更低。在四个编码和工具使用数据集上的实验表明，在这种情况下，监控器未能报告高风险或低正确性动作的频率更高。值得注意的是，明确声明动作来自监控器本身并不会诱导这种偏差。这一发现表明，当前基于固定示例的监控器评估方法可能高估了其在实际部署中的可靠性，可能导致部署不充分的AI智能体。
AI.keywords: 自我归因偏差, AI监控器, 智能体系统, 语言模型, 评估偏差
AI.comments: 这篇论文揭示了AI自监控系统中的一个关键且此前可能被忽视的偏差——“自我归因偏差”。这一发现对于智能体AI的可靠性和安全性具有重要意义。论文指出，是隐式地将行动归因于AI而非明确的声明导致了这种偏差，这提供了深刻的见解。它强调了需要更健壮和实际的AI监控器评估方法，超越固定示例，以更好地反映其在实际部署中的操作场景。这项工作对开发和部署值得信赖的AI智能体具有重要的启示。

title: Overcoming Latency-bound Limitations of Distributed Graph Algorithms using the HPX Runtime System
comments: IEEE-format paper, submitted to GrAPL Workshop at IPDPS conference. 4 authors, 12 Pages
summary: Graph processing at scale presents many challenges, including the irregular structure of graphs, the latency-bound nature of graph algorithms, and the overhead associated with distributed execution. While existing frameworks such as Spark GraphX and the Parallel Boost Graph Library (PBGL) have introduced abstractions for distributed graph processing, they continue to struggle with inherent issues like load imbalance and synchronization overhead. In this work, we present a distributed library prototype and a distributed implementation of three key graph algorithms - Breadth-First Search (BFS), PageRank, and Triangle Counting, using C++ mechanisms from the NWgraph library and leveraging HPX's distributed containers and asynchronous constructs. These algorithms span the categories of Traversal, centrality, and Pattern matching, and are selected to represent diverse computational characteristics. We evaluate our HPX-based implementations against GraphX, and PBGL, showing that a high-performance runtime such as HPX enables the construction of algorithms that significantly outperform conventional frameworks by exploiting asynchronous execution, latency hiding, and fine-grained parallelism in shared memory. All algorithms in our prototype follow a unified execution model in which local and remote computations are expressed using the same programming abstractions, with asynchrony managed transparently by the runtime. This design explicitly leverages shared-memory parallelism within each locality while overlapping communication and computation across localities, providing a practical foundation for extending this approach to a broader class of distributed graph algorithms.
comment: IEEE-format paper, submitted to GrAPL Workshop at IPDPS conference. 4 authors, 12 Pages

AI.title_translation: 使用HPX运行时系统克服分布式图算法的延迟限制
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于HPX运行时系统的分布式图算法实现，通过利用异步执行、延迟隐藏和细粒度并行，显著优于传统的Spark GraphX和PBGL框架。
AI.motivation: 大规模图处理面临挑战，包括图结构不规则、图算法受限于延迟以及分布式执行开销。现有框架如Spark GraphX和PBGL在负载不平衡和同步开销方面存在固有问题。
AI.method: 本研究使用C++的NWgraph库和HPX的分布式容器及异步构造，实现了一个分布式库原型和三个关键图算法（广度优先搜索、PageRank、三角形计数）。这些算法遵循统一的执行模型，由运行时透明管理异步性，并利用共享内存并行性，同时重叠跨区域的通信和计算。
AI.result: HPX基于的实现显著优于GraphX和PBGL等传统框架，通过利用异步执行、延迟隐藏和共享内存中的细粒度并行性。所有算法在原型中遵循统一的执行模型，本地和远程计算使用相同的编程抽象表达。
AI.conclusion: HPX等高性能运行时系统能够构建显著优于传统框架的分布式图算法，通过利用异步执行、延迟隐藏和细粒度并行。这种设计为将该方法推广到更广泛的分布式图算法提供了实用基础。
AI.translation: 大规模图处理带来了许多挑战，包括图结构不规则、图算法受限于延迟以及与分布式执行相关的开销。尽管Spark GraphX和Parallel Boost Graph Library (PBGL) 等现有框架引入了分布式图处理的抽象，但它们仍然在负载不平衡和同步开销等固有问题上挣扎。在这项工作中，我们利用NWgraph库的C++机制，并利用HPX的分布式容器和异步构造，提出了一个分布式库原型以及三个关键图算法（广度优先搜索（BFS）、PageRank和三角形计数）的分布式实现。这些算法涵盖了遍历、中心性和模式匹配等类别，并被选中以代表不同的计算特性。我们将我们基于HPX的实现与GraphX和PBGL进行了评估，结果表明，HPX等高性能运行时系统能够构建显著优于传统框架的算法，通过利用异步执行、延迟隐藏和共享内存中的细粒度并行性。我们原型中的所有算法都遵循统一的执行模型，其中本地和远程计算使用相同的编程抽象表达，异步性由运行时透明管理。这种设计明确利用了每个区域内的共享内存并行性，同时重叠了跨区域的通信和计算，为将这种方法扩展到更广泛的分布式图算法提供了实用的基础。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了一种利用HPX运行时系统克服分布式图算法延迟限制的方法。研究人员使用C++的NWgraph库和HPX的分布式特性，实现并评估了BFS、PageRank和三角形计数这三种关键图算法。实验结果表明，与Spark GraphX和PBGL等传统框架相比，基于HPX的实现通过异步执行、延迟隐藏和细粒度并行显著提高了性能。该方法采用统一的执行模型，透明管理异步性，并有效结合了共享内存并行与跨区域的通信计算重叠。
AI.keywords: 分布式图算法, HPX, 运行时系统, 延迟隐藏, 异步执行
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于利用HPX运行时系统的高级特性（如异步执行、延迟隐藏和细粒度并行）来解决分布式图算法的性能瓶颈。其重要性在于提供了一种构建高性能分布式图算法的实用方法，并展示了在处理大规模不规则图数据时的巨大潜力。它证明了底层高性能运行时系统在优化复杂分布式算法方面的关键作用。

title: ELLIPSE: Evidential Learning for Robust Waypoints and Uncertainties
summary: Robust waypoint prediction is crucial for mobile robots operating in open-world, safety-critical settings. While Imitation Learning (IL) methods have demonstrated great success in practice, they are susceptible to distribution shifts: the policy can become dangerously overconfident in unfamiliar states. In this paper, we present \textit{ELLIPSE}, a method building on multivariate deep evidential regression to output waypoints and multivariate Student-t predictive distributions in a single forward pass. To reduce covariate-shift-induced overconfidence under viewpoint and pose perturbations near expert trajectories, we introduce a lightweight domain augmentation procedure that synthesizes plausible viewpoint/pose variations without collecting additional demonstrations. To improve uncertainty reliability under environment/domain shift (e.g., unseen staircases), we apply a post-hoc isotonic recalibration on probability integral transform (PIT) values so that prediction sets remain plausible during deployment. We ground the discussion and experiments in staircase waypoint prediction, where obtaining robust waypoint and uncertainty is pivotal. Extensive real world evaluations show that \textit{ELLIPSE} improves both task success rate and uncertainty coverage compared to baselines.

AI.title_translation: ELLIPSE：用于鲁棒路径点和不确定性的证据学习
AI.tldr: ELLIPSE通过深度证据回归和领域增强/校准技术，解决了模仿学习在机器人导航中因分布变化导致的过度自信问题，实现了更鲁棒的路径点预测和更可靠的不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习（IL）方法在开放世界、安全关键环境中容易受到分布变化的影响，导致策略在不熟悉的状态下过度自信，这对于移动机器人是危险的。需要一种更鲁棒的路径点预测方法来处理这些不确定性。
AI.method: ELLIPSE方法基于多变量深度证据回归，在一个前向传播中输出路径点和多变量Student-t预测分布。它引入了轻量级的领域增强来合成视角/姿态变化，并对概率积分变换（PIT）值应用了后处理的等渗校准来提高不确定性的可靠性。
AI.result: 大量的真实世界评估表明，与基线方法相比，ELLIPSE提高了任务成功率和不确定性覆盖范围。
AI.conclusion: ELLIPSE在台阶路径点预测任务中，通过改进的不确定性量化方法，提高了任务成功率和不确定性覆盖范围。
AI.translation: 鲁棒的路径点预测对于在开放世界、安全关键环境中运行的移动机器人至关重要。虽然模仿学习（IL）方法在实践中取得了巨大成功，但它们容易受到分布变化的影响：策略可能在不熟悉的状态下变得危险地过度自信。在本文中，我们提出了\textit{ELLIPSE}，一种建立在多变量深度证据回归之上的方法，可以在一次前向传播中输出路径点和多变量Student-t预测分布。为了减少由视角和姿态扰动引起的、靠近专家轨迹时的协变量偏移引起的过度自信，我们引入了一种轻量级的领域增强过程，该过程可以在不收集额外演示的情况下合成合理的视角/姿态变化。为了提高在环境/领域偏移（例如，未见过的楼梯）下的不确定性可靠性，我们在概率积分变换（PIT）值上应用了后处理的等渗校准，以便预测集在部署期间保持合理。我们将讨论和实验建立在楼梯路径点预测的基础上，其中获得鲁棒的路径点和不确定性是至关重要的。大量的真实世界评估表明，\textit{ELLIPSE}与基线方法相比，提高了任务成功率和不确定性覆盖范围。
AI.summary: ELLIPSE是一种用于鲁棒路径点预测的新方法，它利用多变量深度证据回归同时输出路径点和多变量Student-t预测分布。它通过轻量级的领域增强来应对视角/姿态扰动引起的不确定性，并通过对PIT值进行等渗校准来提高在环境/领域偏移下的不确定性可靠性。实验证明其在台阶路径点预测任务中表现更优。
AI.keywords: 鲁棒路径点预测, 证据学习, 多变量深度证据回归, 不确定性量化, 领域适应
AI.comments: ELLIPSE的创新点在于将多变量深度证据回归应用于机器人路径点预测，同时输出路径点和多变量Student-t预测分布。它还引入了轻量级的领域增强来处理视角和姿态扰动，并通过后处理的等渗校准来提高不确定性估计在环境/领域偏移下的可靠性。这对于安全关键应用非常重要。

title: Industrial Survey on Robustness Testing In Cyber Physical Systems
summary: Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) play a critical role in modern industrial domains, including manufacturing, energy, transportation, and healthcare, where they enable automation, optimization, and real-time decision-making. Ensuring the robustness of these systems is paramount, as failures can have significant economic, operational, and safety consequences. This paper present findings from an industrial survey conducted in Wallonia, covering a wide range of sectors, to assess the current state of practice in CPS robustness. It investigates robustness from how it is understood and applied in relationship with requirements engineering, system design, test execution, failure modes, and available tools. It identifies key challenges and gaps between industry practices and state-of-the-art methodologies. Additionally, it compares our findings with similar industrial surveys from the literature.

title: ECG-MoE: Mixture-of-Expert Electrocardiogram Foundation Model
summary: Electrocardiography (ECG) analysis is crucial for cardiac diagnosis, yet existing foundation models often fail to capture the periodicity and diverse features required for varied clinical tasks. We propose ECG-MoE, a hybrid architecture that integrates multi-model temporal features with a cardiac period-aware expert module. Our approach uses a dual-path Mixture-of-Experts to separately model beat-level morphology and rhythm, combined with a hierarchical fusion network using LoRA for efficient inference. Evaluated on five public clinical tasks, ECG-MoE achieves state-of-the-art performance with 40% faster inference than multi-task baselines.

title: From Static Inference to Dynamic Interaction: Navigating the Landscape of Streaming Large Language Models
summary: Standard Large Language Models (LLMs) are predominantly designed for static inference with pre-defined inputs, which limits their applicability in dynamic, real-time scenarios. To address this gap, the streaming LLM paradigm has emerged. However, existing definitions of streaming LLMs remain fragmented, conflating streaming generation, streaming inputs, and interactive streaming architectures, while a systematic taxonomy is still lacking. This paper provides a comprehensive overview and analysis of streaming LLMs. First, we establish a unified definition of streaming LLMs based on data flow and dynamic interaction to clarify existing ambiguities. Building on this definition, we propose a systematic taxonomy of current streaming LLMs and conduct an in-depth discussion on their underlying methodologies. Furthermore, we explore the applications of streaming LLMs in real-world scenarios and outline promising research directions to support ongoing advances in streaming intelligence. We maintain a continuously updated repository of relevant papers at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Awesome-Streaming-LLMs.

title: A Late-Fusion Multimodal AI Framework for Privacy-Preserving Deduplication in National Healthcare Data Environments
comments: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Accepted for publication in the 2025 IEEE International Conference on Future Machine Learning and Data Science (FMLDS)
summary: Duplicate records pose significant challenges in customer relationship management (CRM)and healthcare, often leading to inaccuracies in analytics, impaired user experiences, and compliance risks. Traditional deduplication methods rely heavily on direct identifiers such as names, emails, or Social Security Numbers (SSNs), making them ineffective under strict privacy regulations like GDPR and HIPAA, where such personally identifiable information (PII) is restricted or masked. In this research, I propose a novel, scalable, multimodal AI framework for detecting duplicates without depending on sensitive information. This system leverages three distinct modalities: semantic embeddings derived from textual fields (names, cities) using pre-trained DistilBERT models, behavioral patterns extracted from user login timestamps, and device metadata encoded through categorical embeddings. These heterogeneous modalities are combined using a late fusion approach and clustered via DBSCAN, an unsupervised density-based algorithm. This proposed model is evaluated against a traditional string-matching baseline on a synthetic CRM dataset specifically designed to reflect privacy-preserving constraints. The multimodal framework demonstrated good performance, achieving a good F1-score by effectively identifying duplicates despite variations and noise inherent in the data. This approach offers a privacy-compliant solution to entity resolution and supports secure digital infrastructure, enhances the reliability of public health analytics, and promotes ethical AI adoption across government and enterprise settings. It is well-suited for integration into national health data modernization efforts, aligning with broader goals of privacy-first innovation.

title: Bootstrapping Exploration with Group-Level Natural Language Feedback in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) typically receive diverse natural language (NL) feedback through interaction with the environment. However, current reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms rely solely on scalar rewards, leaving the rich information in NL feedback underutilized and leading to inefficient exploration. In this work, we propose GOLF, an RL framework that explicitly exploits group-level language feedback to guide targeted exploration through actionable refinements. GOLF aggregates two complementary feedback sources: (i) external critiques that pinpoint errors or propose targeted fixes, and (ii) intra-group attempts that supply alternative partial ideas and diverse failure patterns. These group-level feedbacks are aggregated to produce high-quality refinements, which are adaptively injected into training as off-policy scaffolds to provide targeted guidance in sparse-reward regions. Meanwhile, GOLF jointly optimizes generation and refinement within a unified RL loop, creating a virtuous cycle that continuously improves both capabilities. Experiments on both verifiable and non-verifiable benchmarks show that GOLF achieves superior performance and exploration efficiency, achieving 2.2$\times$ improvements in sample efficiency compared to RL methods trained solely on scalar rewards. Code is available at https://github.com/LuckyyySTA/GOLF.

title: PinPoint: Evaluation of Composed Image Retrieval with Explicit Negatives, Multi-Image Queries, and Paraphrase Testing
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) has made significant progress, yet current benchmarks are limited to single ground-truth answers and lack the annotations needed to evaluate false positive avoidance, robustness and multi-image reasoning. We present PinPoint, a comprehensive real world benchmark with 7,635 queries and 329K relevance judgments across 23 query categories. PinPoint advances the field by providing: (1) multiple correct answers (averaging 9.1 per query) (2) explicit hard negatives, (3) six instruction paraphrases per query for robustness testing, (4) multi-image composition support (13.4% of queries), and (5) demographic metadata for fairness evaluation. Based on our analysis of 20+ methods across 4 different major paradigms, we uncover three significant drawbacks: The best methods while achieving mAP@10 of 28.5%, still retrieves irrelevant results (hard negatives) 9% of the time. The best models also exhibit 25.1% performance variation across paraphrases, indicating significant potential for enhancing current CIR techniques. Multi-image queries performs 40 to 70% worse across different methods. To overcome these new issues uncovered by our evaluation framework, we propose a training-free reranking method based on an off-the-shelf MLLM that can be applied to any existing system to bridge the gap. We release the complete dataset, including all images, queries, annotations, retrieval index, and benchmarking code.

title: Vibe Code Bench: Evaluating AI Models on End-to-End Web Application Development
comments: Live leaderboard hosted here: https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/vibe-code. Preprint, currently under review. Benchmark first released Nov 2025
summary:
Code generation has emerged as one of AI's highest-impact use cases, yet existing benchmarks measure isolated tasks rather than the complete "zero-to-one" process of building a working application from scratch. We introduce Vibe Code Bench, a benchmark of 100 web application specifications (50 public validation, 50 held-out test) with 964 browser-based workflows comprising 10,131 substeps, evaluated against deployed applications by an autonomous browser agent.
  Across 16 frontier models, the best achieves only 58.0% accuracy on the test split, revealing that reliable end-to-end application development remains a frontier challenge. We identify self-testing during generation as a strong performance predictor (Pearson r=0.72), and show through a completed human alignment study that evaluator selection materially affects outcomes (31.8-93.6% pairwise step-level agreement).
  Our contributions include (1) a novel benchmark dataset and browser-based evaluation pipeline for end-to-end web application development, (2) a comprehensive evaluation of 16 frontier models with cost, latency, and error analysis, and (3) an evaluator alignment protocol with both cross-model and human annotation results.

title: Risk-Aware Rulebooks for Multi-Objective Trajectory Evaluation under Uncertainty
summary: We present a risk-aware formalism for evaluating system trajectories in the presence of uncertain interactions between the system and its environment. The proposed formalism supports reasoning under uncertainty and systematically handles complex relationships among requirements and objectives, including hierarchical priorities and non-comparability. Rather than treating the environment as exogenous noise, we explicitly model how each system trajectory influences the environment and evaluate trajectories under the resulting distribution of environment responses. We prove that the formalism induces a preorder on the set of system trajectories, ensuring consistency and preventing cyclic preferences. Finally, we illustrate the approach with an autonomous driving example that demonstrates how the formalism enhances explainability by clarifying the rationale behind trajectory selection.

title: PDE foundation model-accelerated inverse estimation of system parameters in inertial confinement fusion
summary: PDE foundation models are typically pretrained on large, diverse corpora of PDE datasets and can be adapted to new settings with limited task-specific data. However, most downstream evaluations focus on forward problems, such as autoregressive rollout prediction. In this work, we study an inverse problem in inertial confinement fusion (ICF): estimating system parameters (inputs) from multi-modal, snapshot-style observations (outputs). Using the open JAG benchmark, which provides hyperspectral X-ray images and scalar observables per simulation, we finetune the PDE foundation model and train a lightweight task-specific head to jointly reconstruct hyperspectral images and regress system parameters. The fine-tuned model achieves accurate hyperspectral reconstruction (test MSE 1.2e-3) and strong parameter-estimation performance (up to R^2=0.995). Data-scaling experiments (5%-100% of the training set) show consistent improvements in both reconstruction and regression losses as the amount of training data increases, with the largest marginal gains in the low-data regime. Finally, finetuning from pretrained MORPH weights outperforms training the same architecture from scratch, demonstrating that foundation-model initialization improves sample efficiency for data-limited inverse problems in ICF.

title: A Case Study in Responsible AI-Assisted Video Solutions: Multi-Metric Behavioral Insights in a Public Market Setting
summary: Despite recent advances in Computer Vision and Artificial Intelligence (AI), AI-assisted video solutions have struggled to penetrate real-world urban environments due to significant concerns regarding privacy, ethical risks, and technical challenges like bias and explainability. This work addresses these barriers through a case study in a city-center public market, demonstrating a pathway for the responsible deployment of AI in community spaces. By adopting a user-centric methodology that prioritizes public trust and privacy safeguards, we show that detailed, operationally relevant behavioral insights can be derived from abstract data representations without compromising ethical standards. The study focuses on generating Multi-Metric Behavioral Insights through the extraction of three complementary signals: customer directional flow, dwell duration, and movement patterns. Utilizing human pose detection and complex behavioral analysis - processed through geometric normalization and motion modeling - the system remains robust under tracking fragmentation and occlusion. Data collected over 18 days, spanning routine operations and a festival window from May 2-4, reveals a consistently right-skewed dwell-time behavior. While most visits last approximately 3-4 minutes, peak activity periods increase the mean to roughly 22 minutes. Furthermore, movement analysis indicates uneven circulation, with over 60% of traffic concentrated in approximately 30% of the venue space. By mapping popular thoroughfares and high-traffic storefronts, this case study provides venue managers and business owners with objective, measurable information to optimize foot traffic. Ultimately, these results demonstrate that AI-enabled video solutions can be successfully integrated into urban environments to provide high-fidelity spatial analytics while maintaining strict adherence to privacy and social responsibility.

title: Can a Building Work as a Reservoir: Footstep Localization with Embedded Accelerometer Networks
summary: Using floor vibrations to accurately predict occupants' footstep locations is essential for smart building operation and privacy-preserving indoor sensing. However, existing approaches are dominated by either physics-based models that rely on simplified wave propagation assumptions and careful calibration, or data-driven methods that require large labeled datasets and often lack robustness to subject and environmental variability. This work introduces a new approach by treating an instrumented building floor as a physical reservoir computer, whose intrinsic structural dynamics can perform nonlinear spatio-temporal computation and information extraction directly. Specifically, foot strike-induced floor vibrations recorded by a distributed accelerometer network are processed using a lightweight physical reservoir computing (PRC) pipeline consisting of short waveform extraction, root-mean-square (RMS) normalization, principal component analysis (PCA), and a weighted linear readout. Results of this study, involving 2 participants and 12 accelerometers, showed that RMS normalization and PCA projection successfully extracted occupant-invariant features from floor-vibration waveform data, enabling a single linear readout to predict foot-strike location across repeated traversals and participants. Sub-meter accuracy is achieved along the hallway direction with moderate sensing coverage, while cross-participant tests achieved meter-scale accuracy without subject-specific recalibration or retraining. These findings demonstrate that building-scale structures can function as capable physical reservoir computers for intelligent monitoring.

title: Beyond Anthropomorphism: a Spectrum of Interface Metaphors for LLMs
comments: Extended Abstracts of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
summary: Anthropomorphizing conversational technology is a natural human tendency. Today, the anthropomorphic metaphor is overly reinforced across intelligent tools. Large Language Models (LLMs) are particularly anthropomorphized through interface design. While metaphors are inherently partial, anthropomorphic interfaces highlight similarities between LLMs and humans, but mask crucial differences. As a result, the metaphor is often taken literally; users treat LLMs as if they are truly human. With few safeguards in place, this extreme anthropomorphism drives users to delusion and harm. Users also experience dissonance between the ethics of using LLMs, their growing ubiquity, and limited interface alternatives. We propose repositioning anthropomorphism as a design variable, developing opposing extremes as a theoretical framework for how interface metaphors shape and can disrupt the default metaphor. We introduce a spectrum of metaphors from transparency-driven ''anti-anthropomorphism'' to uncanny ''hyper-anthropomorphism''. These metaphors introduce materiality to interface metaphors, exposing LLMs as sociotechnical systems shaped by human labor, infrastructure, and data. This spectrum shifts interface design away from optimizing usability and toward encouraging critical engagement.
comment: Extended Abstracts of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems

title: SGR3 Model: Scene Graph Retrieval-Reasoning Model in 3D
summary: 3D scene graphs provide a structured representation of object entities and their relationships, enabling high-level interpretation and reasoning for robots while remaining intuitively understandable to humans. Existing approaches for 3D scene graph generation typically combine scene reconstruction with graph neural networks (GNNs). However, such pipelines require multi-modal data that may not always be available, and their reliance on heuristic graph construction can constrain the prediction of relationship triplets. In this work, we introduce a Scene Graph Retrieval-Reasoning Model in 3D (SGR3 Model), a training-free framework that leverages multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for semantic scene graph generation. SGR3 Model bypasses the need for explicit 3D reconstruction. Instead, it enhances relational reasoning by incorporating semantically aligned scene graphs retrieved via a ColPali-style cross-modal framework. To improve retrieval robustness, we further introduce a weighted patch-level similarity selection mechanism that mitigates the negative impact of blurry or semantically uninformative regions. Experiments demonstrate that SGR3 Model achieves competitive performance compared to training-free baselines and on par with GNN-based expert models. Moreover, an ablation study on the retrieval module and knowledge base scale reveals that retrieved external information is explicitly integrated into the token generation process, rather than being implicitly internalized through abstraction.

title: DuaLip-GPU Technical Report
summary:
Large-scale linear programs (LPs) arise in many decision systems, including ranking, allocation, and matching problems that must be solved repeatedly at massive scale. Prior work such as ECLIPSE and LinkedIn's open-source DuaLip showed that ridge-regularized dual ascent with first-order methods can scale to these settings. However, the original implementation was tightly coupled to a small number of schemas and built on a CPU-centric Scala/Spark stack, limiting extensibility and preventing effective use of modern accelerators.
  We present a redesigned solver architecture that decouples problem specification from the optimization engine and targets GPU execution. The system uses an operator-centric programming model in which LP formulations are expressed through composable primitives for dual objective evaluation and blockwise projection operators for decomposable constraint families. This design allows new formulations to be added locally while reusing a shared optimization loop, diagnostics, and distributed infrastructure.
